fs-ice-thick.front: Canadian Red Cross clear ice thickness: alone, group, snowmobile?
fs-ice-thick.back: 15 cm, 20 cm, 25 cm. Floating ice is never 100% safe.
fs-ice-thick.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Canadian Red Cross ice thickness for clear blue ice: 15 centimetres to walk alone, 20 centimetres for a group, 25 centimetres for a snowmobile. Ice is never 100 percent safe.">
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
  <text x="200" y="26" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Clear ice: how thick?</text><rect x="35" y="140" width="70" height="90" rx="4" fill="#bfe0f2" stroke="#4a7fb0" stroke-width="2"/><text x="70" y="132" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">15 cm</text><text x="70" y="254" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Walk alone</text><rect x="155" y="110" width="70" height="120" rx="4" fill="#bfe0f2" stroke="#4a7fb0" stroke-width="2"/><text x="190" y="102" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">20 cm</text><text x="190" y="254" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Group</text><rect x="275" y="80" width="70" height="150" rx="4" fill="#bfe0f2" stroke="#4a7fb0" stroke-width="2"/><text x="310" y="72" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">25 cm</text><text x="310" y="254" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Snowmobile</text><line x1="20" y1="230" x2="380" y2="230" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><text x="200" y="288" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Canadian Red Cross. Never 100% safe</text>
</svg>

fs-ice-colour.back: Clear blue strongest, white about half as strong, grey unsafe.
fs-ice-colour.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Ice colour tells strength: clear blue ice is strongest, white opaque snow ice is about half as strong, and grey ice is unsafe. On white ice, double the thickness.">
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
  <text x="200" y="26" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Ice colour tells strength</text><rect x="20" y="60" width="115" height="120" rx="8" fill="#bfe0f2" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="77" y="206" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Clear blue</text><text x="77" y="228" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d32" text-anchor="middle">Strongest</text><rect x="147" y="60" width="115" height="120" rx="8" fill="#eef2f5" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="204" y="206" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">White</text><text x="204" y="228" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#e8590c" text-anchor="middle">About half</text><rect x="274" y="60" width="115" height="120" rx="8" fill="#a7aeb3" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="331" y="206" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Grey</text><text x="331" y="228" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#c0392b" text-anchor="middle">Unsafe</text><text x="200" y="280" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">White ice: double the thickness</text>
</svg>

fs-ice-white.front: On white ice, what do you do with the thickness numbers?

fs-ice-weak.back: Inlets, outlets, springs, moving water, edges by reeds and logs, patches ducks kept open.
fs-ice-weak.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Where ice is thin on a pond or lake: at inlets and outlets, over springs, in patches ducks and geese kept open, and around reeds and logs. Ice on moving water and near edges can never be trusted.">
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
  <text x="200" y="26" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Where ice is thin</text><rect x="20" y="50" width="360" height="200" rx="40" fill="#bfe0f2" stroke="#4a7fb0" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 120 L80 140" fill="none" stroke="#2f5f88" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><text x="70" y="104" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Inlet</text><path d="M320 230 L380 250" fill="none" stroke="#2f5f88" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><text x="320" y="216" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Outlet</text><circle cx="200" cy="150" r="22.0" fill="#2f5f88"/><text x="200" y="194" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Spring</text><ellipse cx="290" cy="100" rx="40" ry="18" fill="#2f5f88"/><text x="290" y="80" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Ducks kept open</text><line x1="60" y1="220" x2="60" y2="196" stroke="#8a9a6b" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="70" y1="220" x2="70" y2="196" stroke="#8a9a6b" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="80" y1="220" x2="80" y2="196" stroke="#8a9a6b" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="90" y1="220" x2="90" y2="196" stroke="#8a9a6b" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="100" y1="220" x2="100" y2="196" stroke="#8a9a6b" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="110" y1="220" x2="110" y2="196" stroke="#8a9a6b" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><text x="90" y="240" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Reeds, logs</text><text x="200" y="285" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Moving water and edges: never trust</text>
</svg>

fs-ice-ducks.front: Why is ice near where ducks sat dangerous?
fs-ice-ducks.back: Birds kept that water open longer, so the ice there is very thin.

fs-ice-test.back: Look from shore for open water, grey or slush; chisel and measure; test again every few steps.
fs-ice-test.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Test step 2: chop or drill a hole near shore and measure the clear ice. Test again every few steps.">
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
  <text x="200" y="26" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">2. Chisel and measure</text><rect x="0" y="160" width="400" height="140" rx="0" fill="#bfe0f2"/><rect x="150" y="160" width="100" height="40" rx="0" fill="#2f5f88"/><line x1="200" y1="60" x2="200" y2="170" stroke="#9a9a8f" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><rect x="250" y="160" width="10" height="40" rx="0" fill="#e8590c"/><text x="300" y="186" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start">15 cm?</text><text x="200" y="288" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Measure, do not guess</text>
</svg>

fs-ice-spread.front: Two hunters crossing ice: side by side?
fs-ice-spread.back: No. Spread out with a gap, PFDs on, picks on your neck.
fs-ice-spread.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Test step 3: walk spread out, not side by side, with a PFD on and ice picks around your neck.">
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
  <text x="200" y="26" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">3. Spread out, PFD on</text><rect x="0" y="160" width="400" height="140" rx="0" fill="#bfe0f2"/><line x1="94" y1="220" x2="97" y2="196" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="5.6000000000000005" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="106" y1="220" x2="103" y2="196" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="5.6000000000000005" stroke-linecap="round"/><rect x="91" y="174" width="18" height="25" rx="4.800000000000001" fill="#e8590c"/><line x1="92" y1="178" x2="86" y2="195" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="4.800000000000001" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="108" y1="178" x2="114" y2="195" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="4.800000000000001" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="100" cy="167" r="8.0" fill="#d9b48f"/><line x1="294" y1="220" x2="297" y2="196" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="5.6000000000000005" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="306" y1="220" x2="303" y2="196" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="5.6000000000000005" stroke-linecap="round"/><rect x="291" y="174" width="18" height="25" rx="4.800000000000001" fill="#f6c344"/><line x1="292" y1="178" x2="286" y2="195" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="4.800000000000001" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="308" y1="178" x2="314" y2="195" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="4.800000000000001" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="300" cy="167" r="8.0" fill="#d9b48f"/><line x1="130" y1="200" x2="270" y2="200" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="6 6"/><text x="200" y="190" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Gap</text><text x="200" y="288" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Gap between you, PFD zipped</text>
</svg>

fs-ice-kit.back: Ice picks, PFD, floating throw rope, chisel, phone in a dry bag, dry clothes in the truck.
fs-ice-kit.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Ice kit: ice picks around the neck, a PFD worn, a floating throw rope, an ice chisel to test ahead, a phone in a dry bag, and dry clothes in the truck.">
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
  <text x="200" y="26" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Ice kit</text><rect x="30" y="46" width="80" height="40" rx="6" fill="#e8590c" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="1"/><text x="70" y="106" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Ice picks</text><text x="70" y="124" font-size="14" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">around neck</text><rect x="160" y="46" width="80" height="40" rx="6" fill="#e8590c" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="1"/><text x="200" y="106" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">PFD</text><text x="200" y="124" font-size="14" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">worn</text><rect x="290" y="46" width="80" height="40" rx="6" fill="#4a7fb0" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="1"/><text x="330" y="106" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Throw rope</text><text x="330" y="124" font-size="14" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">floating</text><rect x="30" y="146" width="80" height="40" rx="6" fill="#9a9a8f" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="1"/><text x="70" y="206" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Chisel</text><text x="70" y="224" font-size="14" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">test ahead</text><rect x="160" y="146" width="80" height="40" rx="6" fill="#2f3a2b" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="1"/><text x="200" y="206" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Phone</text><text x="200" y="224" font-size="14" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">in a dry bag</text><rect x="290" y="146" width="80" height="40" rx="6" fill="#7c5a99" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="1"/><text x="330" y="206" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Dry clothes</text><text x="330" y="224" font-size="14" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">in the truck</text>
</svg>

fs-ice-bird.front: A duck falls on thin ice. Retrieve it?
fs-ice-bird.back: No. Let it go. Plan shots so birds fall on open water or land.
fs-ice-bird.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="A bird falls on thin ice: do not walk out for it. Let it go. A duck is not worth your life. Plan your shots so birds fall on land or open water you can reach by boat.">
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
  <text x="200" y="26" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Bird down on thin ice?</text><rect x="0" y="150" width="400" height="150" rx="0" fill="#bfe0f2"/><rect x="0" y="130" width="400" height="24" rx="0" fill="#dfe6d3"/><line x1="53" y1="150" x2="56" y2="124" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="6.3" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="67" y1="150" x2="64" y2="124" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="6.3" stroke-linecap="round"/><rect x="50" y="98" width="20" height="28" rx="5.4" fill="#e8590c"/><line x1="51" y1="103" x2="44" y2="122" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="5.4" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="69" y1="103" x2="76" y2="122" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="5.4" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="60" cy="90" r="9.0" fill="#d9b48f"/><ellipse cx="270" cy="200" rx="18" ry="9" fill="#8b5a2b"/><line x1="80" y1="140" x2="260" y2="196" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="6 6"/><line x1="157" y1="155" x2="183" y2="181" stroke="#c0392b" stroke-width="7.0" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="183" y1="155" x2="157" y2="181" stroke="#c0392b" stroke-width="7.0" stroke-linecap="round"/><text x="270" y="110" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#c0392b" text-anchor="middle">Let it go</text><text x="270" y="240" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">A duck is not worth it</text><text x="200" y="285" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Plan shots so birds fall on land or open water</text>
</svg>

fs-ice-clothes.front: In the water: take off your heavy coat?
fs-ice-clothes.back: No. Winter clothes trap air for warmth and flotation.

fs-ice-turn.front: Fell through: which way do you face?
fs-ice-turn.back: Back the way you came. That ice held you.
fs-ice-turn.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Self rescue step 2: turn back toward the direction you came from, the ice behind you. That ice held you.">
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
  <text x="200" y="26" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">2. Turn back the way you came</text><rect x="0" y="130" width="400" height="30" rx="0" fill="#bfe0f2"/><rect x="150" y="130" width="100" height="170" rx="0" fill="#2f5f88"/><circle cx="200" cy="142" r="14.0" fill="#d9b48f"/><path d="M30 146 L150 146" fill="none" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-dasharray="6 6"/><line x1="190" y1="110" x2="122" y2="110" stroke="#e8590c" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><polygon points="110,110 122,117 122,103" fill="#e8590c"/><text x="90" y="90" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Came from here</text><line x1="80" y1="160" x2="80" y2="214" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="1.6"/><circle cx="80" cy="160" r="3" fill="#2f3a2b"/><rect x="12" y="214" width="136" height="54" rx="6" fill="#2f3a2b"/><text x="80" y="237" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">That ice</text><text x="80" y="258" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">held you</text>
</svg>

fs-ice-out.front: How do you get out of an ice hole?
fs-ice-out.back: Arms on the solid ice, kick flat, dig in picks, slide out on your belly.

fs-ice-roll.front: Out of the hole: stand up?
fs-ice-roll.back: No. Lie flat and roll away several body lengths.
fs-ice-roll.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Self rescue step 4: slide out on your belly, then roll away from the hole. Do not stand up near it.">
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
  <text x="200" y="26" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">4. Slide out, roll away</text><rect x="0" y="130" width="400" height="30" rx="0" fill="#bfe0f2"/><rect x="300" y="130" width="90" height="170" rx="0" fill="#2f5f88"/><rect x="120" y="120" width="80" height="16" rx="6" fill="#e8590c"/><circle cx="110" cy="126" r="12.0" fill="#d9b48f"/><path d="M200 122 L232 118 M200 132 L230 138" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M120 152 C140 172 180 172 196 152" fill="none" stroke="#e8590c" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="6 5"/><line x1="220" y1="110" x2="152" y2="110" stroke="#e8590c" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><polygon points="140,110 152,117 152,103" fill="#e8590c"/><text x="200" y="90" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#c0392b" text-anchor="middle">Roll, do not stand</text><rect x="12" y="214" width="136" height="54" rx="6" fill="#2f3a2b"/><text x="80" y="237" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">Roll several</text><text x="80" y="258" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">body lengths</text>
</svg>

fs-ice-help.front: Someone else falls in: order of help?
fs-ice-help.back: Call 911, then preach, reach, throw, row. Go only as a last resort.
fs-ice-help.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Someone else fell through the ice: call 911 first. Preach: shout to them to kick and hold on. Reach: a pole or branch from shore. Throw: a rope or something that floats. Go: last resort only, never run out to the hole.">
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
  <text x="200" y="26" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Someone else went in</text><rect x="30" y="44" width="340" height="38" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#2f3a2b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="46" y="69" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start">Call 911</text><text x="160" y="69" font-size="15" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start">first</text><rect x="30" y="90" width="340" height="38" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#2e7d32" stroke-width="2"/><text x="46" y="115" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d32" text-anchor="start">Preach</text><text x="160" y="115" font-size="15" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start">shout: kick, hold on</text><rect x="30" y="136" width="340" height="38" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#2e7d32" stroke-width="2"/><text x="46" y="161" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d32" text-anchor="start">Reach</text><text x="160" y="161" font-size="15" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start">pole, branch, from shore</text><rect x="30" y="182" width="340" height="38" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#2e7d32" stroke-width="2"/><text x="46" y="207" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2e7d32" text-anchor="start">Throw</text><text x="160" y="207" font-size="15" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start">rope or floater</text><rect x="30" y="228" width="340" height="38" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#c0392b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="46" y="253" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#c0392b" text-anchor="start">Go</text><text x="160" y="253" font-size="15" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="start">last resort only</text>
</svg>

fs-ice-edge.front: Run to the edge of the hole to help?
fs-ice-edge.back: No. You may go in too. Reach or throw from solid ground.

fs-ice-after.front: After a cold water rescue, why handle gently?
fs-ice-after.back: Afterdrop and sudden collapse can follow rescue. Keep them flat, rewarm the trunk.

fs-ice-wade.back: Face upstream, pole as a third leg, hip belt open, one foot at a time. Over the knee and fast: find another way.
fs-ice-wade.diagram:
